introHtml: Poly propylene blenders and shakers are a smart choice for businesses that need lightweight, durable drinkware that stands up to daily use. Unlike glass or stainless steel, poly propylene is shatter-resistant and dishwasher-safe, making it ideal for gyms, corporate wellness programs, and outdoor events. These custom shakers keep your brand visible during workouts or on the go, with room for a full logo imprint using screen printing or pad printing. Whether you're stocking a company store or preparing a trade show giveaway, poly propylene blenders and shakers offer a practical, cost-effective way to promote your brand.
